sourceRefs.locator: Abstract; Supplementary Discussion pp. 2–6: L13, ochre composition, smoothed silcrete and experimental marking
p. 1, paragraphs 3–5: archaeological stratum around 73 ka, nine deliberately drawn lines; p. 2 distinguishes drawing and engraving

summary.de: Fundort an der heutigen südafrikanischen Südküste. Aus einer Schicht der Middle Stone Age stammt das Silcretstück L13 mit einer Ockerzeichnung.
summary.en: A site on the present-day southern coast of South Africa. A Middle Stone Age layer yielded silcrete fragment L13 with an ochre drawing.
